entries.raw: *Four [[Israeli settlement|Israeli settlers]], including a pregnant woman, are shot dead in a shooting outside [[Kiryat Arba]], when a gunman opens fire on their car. [[Hamas]] claims responsibility for the murder. [http://www.haaretz.com/news/diplomacy-defense/four-israelis-killed-in-shooting-attack-near-hebron-1.311318 (Haaretz)]
entries.text: Four Israeli settlers, including a pregnant woman, are shot dead in a shooting outside Kiryat Arba, when a gunman opens fire on their car. Hamas claims responsibility for the murder.

entries.raw: *A gunman [[2010 Bratislava shootings|opens fire]] in [[Devínska Nová Ves]], a borough of the [[Slovakia|Slovak]] capital [[Bratislava]], killing 8 people and injuring 14 others. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-11129844 (BBC)] [http://www.dw-world.de/dw/article/0,,5956939,00.html (Deutsche Welle)] [http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/aug/31/bratislava-shooting-spree-slovakia (''The Guardian'')] [http://www.thehindu.com/news/international/article604068.ece (AP via ''The Hindu'')] [http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-08/31/c_13470032.htm (Xinhua)] [http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2010/08/2010830103838162971.html (Aljazeera)]
entries.text: A gunman opens fire in Devínska Nová Ves, a borough of the Slovak capital Bratislava, killing 8 people and injuring 14 others.

entries.raw: *[[Marco Antonio Leal García]], the Mayor of [[Hidalgo Municipality, Tamaulipas| Hidalgo, Tamaulipas]], in northeastern Mexico, is shot dead while operating his car; his 4-year-old daughter is wounded. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-11127005 (BBC)]
entries.text: Marco Antonio Leal García, the Mayor of Hidalgo, Tamaulipas, in northeastern Mexico, is shot dead while operating his car; his 4-year-old daughter is wounded.

entries.raw: *The presidential palace in [[Somalia]] is shelled. [http://english.aljazeera.net/news/africa/2010/08/2010830155656429103.html (Aljazeera)]
entries.text: The presidential palace in Somalia is shelled.

entries.raw: *6 civilians are killed and 19 others are injured in a shelling incident in [[Mogadishu]]. [http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/aug/30/10-die-mogadishu-fighting-somalia (''The Guardian'')]
entries.text: 6 civilians are killed and 19 others are injured in a shelling incident in Mogadishu.

entries.raw: *4 [[African Union]] peacekeepers from [[Uganda]] are killed during a mortar strike in [[Mogadishu]], Somalia.  [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-11131813 (BBC)] [http://www.france24.com/en/20100830-four-ugandan-peacekeepers-killed-fresh-clashes-somalia-al-shabaab (AFP via France24)]
entries.text: 4 African Union peacekeepers from Uganda are killed during a mortar strike in Mogadishu, Somalia.

entries.raw: *4 people are killed and 3 others are injured due to a [[rocket launcher]] explosion in [[Pursat Province]], northwestern [[Cambodia]]. [http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-08/30/c_13469997.htm (Xinhua)]
entries.text: 4 people are killed and 3 others are injured due to a rocket launcher explosion in Pursat Province, northwestern Cambodia.

entries.raw: *Two [[Russia]]n pilots are abducted in [[Sudan]]'s western [[Darfur]] region. [http://en.rian.ru/russia/20100830/160389224.html (RIA Novosti)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-11128905 (BBC)]
entries.text: Two Russian pilots are abducted in Sudan's western Darfur region.

entries.raw: *Gunmen kidnap a politician in southern [[Nigeria]], days after a supporter of [[President of Nigeria|President]] [[Goodluck Jonathan]] was also kidnapped. [http://www.news24.com/Africa/News/Nigerian-politician-kidnapped-20100830 (News24)] [http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-08/30/c_13469952.htm (Xinhua)]
entries.text: Gunmen kidnap a politician in southern Nigeria, days after a supporter of President Goodluck Jonathan was also kidnapped.

entries.raw: *It is announced that [[Isabella Rossellini]] is to chair the judging panel at the [[Berlin International Film Festival]] in [[61st Berlin International Film Festival|2011]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-11130680 (BBC)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSTRE67T3EX20100830 (Reuters)] [http://www.upi.com/Entertainment_News/Movies/2010/08/30/Actress-Rossellini-to-lead-Berlin-jury/UPI-43761283195817/ (UPI)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/films/isabella-rossellini-to-head-berlin-film-festival-jury-2066047.html (AFP via ''The Independent'')]
entries.text: It is announced that Isabella Rossellini is to chair the judging panel at the Berlin International Film Festival in 2011.

entries.raw: *Concern is expressed for more than 500 [[Aboriginal peoples in Canada|indigenous women]] who have gone missing in [[Canada]] on the [[International Day of the Disappeared]]. [http://english.aljazeera.net/quoteofday/2010/08/201083018253280225.html (Aljazeera)]
entries.text: Concern is expressed for more than 500 indigenous women who have gone missing in Canada on the International Day of the Disappeared.

entries.text: Alain "Spiderman" Robert climbs another building barehanded, this time in Sydney; he is later arrested.

entries.raw: **Category 4 [[Hurricane Earl (2010)|Hurricane Earl]] takes aim at the northern [[Leeward Islands]] and [[Puerto Rico]] with winds of up to 135 miles per hour (215 km/h) prompting [[hurricane]] warnings. [http://www.msnbc.msn.com/id/38877306/ns/weather/?gt1=43001 (msnbc.com)] [http://www.cnn.com/2010/US/08/30/tropical.weather/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-11128738 (BBC)]
entries.text: Category 4 Hurricane Earl takes aim at the northern Leeward Islands and Puerto Rico with winds of up to 135 miles per hour (215 km/h) prompting hurricane warnings.

entries.text: Tropical Storm Fiona forms in the central Atlantic Ocean with the potential to become the fourth hurricane of the season.

entries.raw: *[[Indonesia]]'s Mount [[Sinabung]] continues to erupt with 21,000 people now evacuated from nearby areas of north [[Sumatra]] and two people dead. entries.text: Indonesia's Mount Sinabung continues to erupt with 21,000 people now evacuated from nearby areas of north Sumatra and two people dead.

entries.text: 9 people die and 480 are rescued following a fire at a retirement home in the Tver region of Russia.

entries.text: It is announced that a preserved corpse belonging to William Holland, an American mountaineer lost in the Canadian Rockies in 1989, has been located in Jasper National Park.

entries.text: 42 killed, 11 injured in bus crash 55 miles south of Quito, Ecuador.

[https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-11127409 (BBC)] [http://www.haaretz.com/blogs/a-special-place-in-hell/a-special-place-in-hell-celebrate-jewish-new-year-with-a-de-occupation-seder-1.311068 (''Haaretz'')]  [http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/Palestinians-should-perish-from-this-world-Ovadia-Yosef/articleshow/6456799.cms (''The Times of India'')]
entries.text: Ovadia Yosef, a senior rabbi from Shas, a party within Israel's coalition government, calls for Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas to "vanish from our world". The United States condemns the remarks as "deeply offensive".

entries.text: China and North Korea acknowledge the leader of North Korea Kim Jong Il visited China recently where he met with the President of China Hu Jintao.

entries.raw: *The [[President of the United States]] [[Barack Obama]] freezes the assets of three [[North Korea]]n organisations and one individual in response to the sinking of a [[South Korea]]n warship in March. North Korea has denied it is responsible. [http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2010/aug/30/north-korea-punished-us-sinking-warship (''The Guardian'')] [http://news.xinhuanet.com/english2010/world/2010-08/31/c_13470034.htm (Xinhua)] [http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2010/08/201083023810958612.html (Aljazeera)]
entries.text: The President of the United States Barack Obama freezes the assets of three North Korean organisations and one individual in response to the sinking of a South Korean warship in March. North Korea has denied it is responsible.

entries.text: More than 100 Russian far-right skinheads attack a music festival in central Russia, injuring at least 10 people and leaving one 14-year-old girl dead.

entries.text: 3,200 police officers have been fired so far this year by Mexico's federal police force due to extracurricular activities.

entries.text: Talks begin between the government and workers striking for better conditions in South Africa in the third week of a conflict which has seen troops deployed.

entries.text: The InterAcademy Panel on International Issues issues a report finding that The IPCC assessment process has been successful overall but making seven formal recommendations for improving the IPCC's assessment process, and that "“Straying into advocacy can only hurt I.P.C.C.’s credibility.”
